modalities.evidence: Data was collected using three wearable devices
including lifting a chair, greeting, gesticulating, walking and running

output.population: A total of 17 healthy volunteers participated in the experimental data acquisition sessions
output.summary: Annotated multimodal biosignals (ECG, EMG, EDA, PPG, temperature, actigraphy) recorded with a chestband, armband and wristband while volunteers performed everyday activities in uncontrolled environments.
